title: Salary + final settlement · Hinglish
input: Maine 30 September 2026 ko resign kiya, notice period bhi serve kiya. Company ne August aur September ki salary nahi di, total ₹84,000 baaki hai. HR bolta hai funds aayenge tab denge. Main Noida me kaam karta tha. Kya kar sakta hoon?
raw:
Maine samajh liya ki aapne 30 September 2026 ko Noida ki company se resign kiya, aur aapki August aur September ki ₹84,000 salary abhi tak nahi mili hai.

**Where you stand**
* Aapki company ke paas rules ke mutabiq resignation ke baad bachi hui salary jaldi dene ki zimmedari thi [[COW-17]].
* Aap [[COW-45]] ke tahat apni mehnat ki kamaai ke liye formal claim daal sakte hain.

**What you can do**
1. Company ko ek written demand email ya letter bhejiye jisme ₹84,000 jaldi dene ko kahiye [[ICA-73]].
2. Agar company tab bhi na maane, toh Noida ke labour authority ya designated officer ke paas apni complaint register kariye [[COW-45]].
3. Agar zaroorat pade aur aapko free legal advice chahiye, toh [[RES-NALSA]] (15100) par call kar sakte hain ya District Legal Services Authority ja sakte hain.

Kya aapke paas resignation ka mail ya letter aur salary slip hai? Aur kis state ya city ki company thi?
